content.title: How to watch WrestleMania 42 in India for free: Live stream, channel, start time for WWE event | Sporting News India
content.text: WrestleMania, the marquee event of the professional wrestling calendar, is back with another enthralling edition.Often likened to the NFL’s championship finale, this wrestling extravaganza represents the absolute peak of sports entertainment.The confirmed card promises an unforgettable weekend of storytelling. The first evening is anchored by a massive Undisputed Championship bout between Randy Orton and Cody Rhodes. Meanwhile, the second evening features a heavy-hitting main event as CM Punk defends his World Heavyweight title against Roman Reigns.From a high-flying six-pack ladder match to the return of legendary figures like AJ Lee and the Bella Twins, the Vegas lights are set to illuminate a night worth remembering.Add The Sporting News as a preferred news sourceWrestleMania 42 live stream, TV channelHere's how to watch WrestleMania 42 in India:TV channel: N/ALive stream: NetflixWrestleMania 42 is available to live stream on on the Netflix app and website. Fans who have existing Netflix subscription can watch it for free. There is no traditional live TV broadcast of WrestleMania 42.What time does WrestleMania 42 start?WrestleMania 42 are locked in for the weekend of April 18 and 19. For Indian audience, that translates to 4:30 AM IST on Sunday, April 19, and Monday, April 20.Where does WrestleMania 42 take place?The chosen battleground for WrestleMania 42 is the opulent Allegiant Stadium in Nevada, an architectural masterpiece valued at $1.9 billion.Renowned for housing the NFL's Las Vegas Raiders and having hosted Super Bowl LVIII, the arena provides a sleek and high-tech backdrop for wrestling’s elite.
